description: This file implements database query services specific to PostgreSQL for the Fineract project. It provides methods to check table existence, retrieve table column details, and fetch index information, utilizing JDBC and Spring Framework components.

classes.name: PostgreSQLQueryService
classes.description: A service class for executing PostgreSQL-specific database queries, such as checking table existence, retrieving column details, and index information.

methods.name: isSupported
methods.description: Checks if the current database type is PostgreSQL.

methods.name: isTablePresent
methods.description: Verifies the existence of a table in the public schema.

methods.name: getTableColumns
methods.description: Retrieves column metadata for a specified table.

methods.name: getTableIndexes
methods.description: Fetches index details for a specified table.
